why.trigger: EP-0007 showed that whole-pool starvation is not structural: the m=N class's flow balance runs from 0.078 at a concurrency of 98.9 up to 0.850 at 7.4. EP-0003's headline -- 'a need distribution whose support contains N starves that class, at rates as low as p=0.0005, even at rho=0.7' -- was written under the assumption that this was a structural trap independent of everything else.
why.stake: EP-0003 is the episode this domain's mechanism story rests on, and it was measured at a single background granularity. If that setting simply sits in the high-concurrency part of the E9 curve, then its conclusion needs the same conditioning every other result now carries, and the domain's central claim has to be restated one more time.

E10.design: hold EP-0003's configuration fixed except for the background granularity, and re-measure. N=64, rho=0.85, p64=0.002 on need=64, theta=0.4 weights on the background.
E10.measured: mean_running (concurrency), flow balance of the need=64 class, its JCT, aggregate mean JCT

predictions.claim: EP-0003's original setting sits in the high-concurrency part of the E9 curve
predictions.falsified_if: below 20, which would mean EP-0003's starvation was NOT a high-concurrency case and the mechanism correction does not explain it

predictions.claim: DECIDING. EP-0003's central result reverses when only the background granularity is coarsened: with the coarse background the need=64 class is no longer starved
predictions.criterion: flow balance of the need=64 class >= 0.5 under greedy SRPT with the coarse background
predictions.falsified_if: still below 0.5, which would mean EP-0003's result survives independently of concurrency and the 'structural' language was closer to right than EP-0007 suggested

predictions.claim: the reversal is monotone in granularity: flow balance of need=64 rises from fine to mid to coarse
EASY backfill is unaffected by the granularity change, as it has been on every other axis
predictions.criterion: flow balance of need=64 under easy_backfill >= 0.9 for all three backgrounds

predictions.claim: the concurrency values land where the E9 curve predicts: the fine and coarse backgrounds differ in concurrency by at least 3x
predictions.falsified_if: the ratio is below 3, meaning the manipulation was too weak to test the claim

pre_committed_consequence.if_X2_passes: EP-0003's headline gets the same conditioning as everything else: a need distribution containing N starves that class ONLY when enough jobs compete for the pool. The domain's central claim is restated as a statement about concurrency, and EP-0003's episode note gets a correction banner pointing at EP-0007/EP-0008.
pre_committed_consequence.if_X2_fails: EP-0003's result is robust to concurrency in a way EP-0007's m=N sweep was not, which would itself be a finding worth chasing -- the two experiments would disagree and something in the construction differs beyond granularity.

declared_unknowns: coarsening the background also raises E[k] of the background, which changes the arrival rate at fixed rho; concurrency and background job size move together here, as in E9
p64 is held at 0.002 rather than EP-0003's full sweep down to 0.0005
